Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request for post-remediation validation and scope amendment (Avalon Health)

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for working with us on the recent penetration test. Our vendor reviewed the remediation summary you sent and we have a couple of follow-ups before we can accept the closure:

- Can you provide a short signed validation letter (one page) confirming the fixes were applied and verified internally?
- Avalon needs a delta report or attestation describing what changed from the original report (high/critical fixes only).
- We would like to amend the original PT scope to include telemetry.example.com (subdomain) for the retest — can you confirm whether that will be included or if you require us to exclude it?

Attachments mentioned: remediation_summary_20270521.pdf (we received a copy but need the verification/attestation).

Target timeline: our internal compliance committee hopes to review the retest results the week of June 14. Is that feasible? Also include a point of contact for invoicing and DocuSign steps if needed.

Appreciate the quick turn here.

Best,
Jenna Alvarez
InfoSec Manager | Avalon Health

Hi Jenna — thanks for the clear ask. We can support the items below and will follow this plan:

1) Validation letter: I will prepare a one-page signed validation letter stating that the remediation items listed in your remediation_summary_20270521.pdf were implemented and that we ran an internal verification pass. Expect a draft by Monday.

2) Delta attestation: Marissa will assemble a short delta document that highlights the high/critical fixes and the verification steps taken. That should include evidence pointers (config exports, policy diffs).

3) Scope amendment: We can include telemetry.example.com in the retest, but we need explicit written acceptance from Avalon (you) for the additional scope. Adding that increases the retest hours and may affect the timeline/cost — Vivek will put together an initial estimate and coordinate the third-party retester.

Tentative schedule: internal verification this week, then we’ll propose 1–2 windows for an external retest during the week of June 14. Can you confirm procurement readiness for that week?

Cc: Marissa — please compile the evidence artifacts (config export, kube policies, and the remediation delta).
Cc: Vivek — please price and confirm availability with PenTech Labs.
